dedupe_keys.name: mic ict statistics database 情報通信統計テータヘース japanese telecom subscriptions facilities operators and surveys

description: The ICT statistics database of Japan's Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications gathers the ministry's data on information and communications. Its field pages for telecommunications cover the internet, subscriptions, telecom facilities, operators, traffic, prices and international comparisons: for example the number of mobile subscriptions, fixed telephone and ISDN lines, IP telephone numbers and domestic leased lines, quarterly broadband subscriptions by technology, quarterly data on subscriptions and market shares of telecom services, public telephone facilities including the NTT East and West breakdown, wired telecom facilities by region and industry, cable broadcasting facilities by region, and the share of subscriber lines held by NTT East and West, with the latest data to March 2026. It also hosts two official statistical surveys, the Communications Usage Trend Survey of households and enterprises (latest results published in May 2026) and the Basic Survey on the Information and Communications Industry, and links the annual White Paper on Information and Communications (2026 edition published in July 2026). Coverage: Japan, mostly national, some regional. Format and access: XLS and CSV tables, PDF reports, free. Caveats: tables use Japanese headings and fiscal years; definitions change over time. Simulation uses: subscription and facility counts for demand and exposure modelling, and household usage patterns for service impact estimates. Related records: the MIC internet traffic aggregation gives traffic, the MIC telecom accident statistics give outages, and the MIC radio station licence search gives sites.
